title: I feel like I can make a game, so I'll try!
content:
RPG Project — A Spark From Golden Sun

 

Some ideas arrive quietly. Others hit you with the same rush you felt the first time a game truly amazed you. This new RPG concept started exactly like that. I found myself going back to Golden Sun, a game that impressed me not only with its world and storytelling, but with something subtle yet unforgettable: its battles. I always wondered how they pulled off those dynamic scenes that looked 2D but moved like 3D — a style so distinct that it stayed with me for years.

 

That feeling of “I want to make something like this” never really left. And now, it’s evolving into a project of its own.

 

Even without sharing any plot yet, here’s what people can expect from this upcoming game idea:

A world shaped with that same sense of wonder Golden Sun sparked.

A battle presentation inspired by pseudo-3D magic, where characters feel alive even without fully realistic models.

A focus on atmosphere and discovery, the kind that makes you pause just to take everything in.

Modern indie simplicity, built with accessible tools but crafted with heart.

 

 

Well, i don't really know how I'll pull this off. But I'm really eager to bring back that nostalgia I felt when playing Golden Sun. 

 

This is just the beginning — a single spark.
But sometimes, that’s all a great adventure needs.
